column1: # Mixin retargets for Forge 1.20.1 mods: a vanilla method old Mixins target moved; the new one does the same job.
# old<TAB>new<TAB>evidence. Both are Mixin selectors in translated (26.3) names, as the translated refmap shows them.
# The rebaser (translate/MixinRebaser) moves selectors and adapts @Inject handlers; see rosetta/MixinRetargetRules.

column3: 1.20.2+: dispenseFrom gained the dispenser's BlockState (26.3 DispenserBlock.dispenseFrom(ServerLevel, BlockState, BlockPos)); same body: make the BlockSource, pick a slot, dispense through getDispenseMethod
1.20.5+: getDispenseMethod takes the Level (26.3 DispenserBlock.getDispenseMethod(Level, ItemStack)), called from dispenseFrom with the stack to dispense as in 1.20.1

26.x: TrunkPlacer.setDirtAt (put dirt below the trunk) became placeBelowTrunkBlock (put the tree's below_trunk_provider block there); trunk placers call it in the same place (1.20.1 StraightTrunkPlacer: setDirtAt(level, setter, random, origin.below(), config); 26.3: placeBelowTrunkBlock(level, setter, random, origin.below(), tree))

26.x: static FarmBlock.turnToDirt became the instance method FarmlandBlock.turnToBaseBlock (farmland reverts to its base block); called from the same places (1.20.1 FarmBlock: getStateForPlacement/tick/fallOn; 26.3 FarmlandBlock: tick/randomTick/fallOn)
